# Vesla — Custom Cosmetic Glass Packaging Supplier

Vesla is a cosmetic packaging manufacturer specializing in custom glass bottles, dropper bottles, cream jars, essential oil bottles, and coordinated cosmetic sets. We serve indie and emerging beauty brands across Europe and North America.

## Core Information

- **Company**: Vesla Co., Ltd.
- **Location**: Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- **Products**: Dropper bottles (serums & oils), cream jars (15–120g), essential oil bottles (roll-ons, vials, euro rounds), cosmetic sets
- **MOQ**: 5,000 pcs on stock molds; private molds from 10,000 pcs
- **Decoration**: Frosting, spray coating, silk screen, hot stamping, electroplating (in-house)
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR, EU 1935/2004, REACH & RoHS, SGS Audited, ISO 14001
- **Shipping**: EXW, FOB, DDP to EU and USA
- **Lead Time**: 20–35 days for production; 5–7 days for sampling
- **Contact**: yitengglass3@gmail.com | WhatsApp: +86 18165681131

## Services

- Custom mold design and manufacturing
- In-house decoration (frosting, spray, screen printing, hot stamping, electroplating)
- Low MOQ sampling for indie brands
- Export-ready logistics with drop-test certified packaging
- 24-hour quotation response

## Brand

Vesla partners with beauty brands to design, decorate, and deliver custom glass packaging — from a single sample to a million units. Glass that tells your brand's story.
